summary: Mr. Mosseri discusses pre-wedding customs, explaining which traditions belong to the community heritage and which originate outside it. He addresses topics such as hennas, marriage classes started by Rabbi Dr. Jacob S. Kassin, pre-wedding sebet, bride and groom communication before the wedding, fasting, and saying Vidui in Minha.

questions: Is a henna party part of our community custom?
Why did Rabbi Dr. Jacob S. Kassin start marriage classes?

Do the hatan and kallah fast on the day of the wedding?
Should a hatan or kallah say Vidui in Minha on their wedding day?
